title: CDU pump fault halves coolant flow; every liquid-cooled GPU on the loop heats up together

expected.reason: Coolant flow halves after pump A faults (pump B alone can't hold flow). Return temperature rises 10C and all GPUs on the loop climb ~17C in 20 minutes, heading for throttling across 2 racks.
keySignals: correlated temp rise across all GPUs cooled_by coolant-loop-02

context.note: Use the graph: every affected GPU has a cooled_by edge to coolant-loop-02 which depends_on cdu-02. One root cause, not 24 separate alerts.
